name: v0.6.0
body:
## Overview

llama.cpp v0.6.0 introduces the new `llama_batch_ext` extended batch API (with `llama_process`) for mixed token/embedding inputs and MTP/deepstack state embeddings, adds support for the GLM-5.3-Flash (GLM5-Next) 320B hybrid model, the Clef decision model (text and vision) and MTP speculative decoding for Qwen4Exp, ships a new `/v1/systemone` server API for decision models (laya, julia-1, lev, openjev, kev, nimble), overhauls the Web UI with a Hugging Face Hub data layer and model download pipeline, adds a Metal tensor-API flash attention kernel for F16 KV, sparse flash attention for quantized K/V on Vulkan, and updates ggml to v0.26.0.

### Highlights

- New `llama_batch_ext` extended batch API with `llama_process()`, supporting mixed token/embedding batches and per-token "state" embeddings for MTP and deepstack models [#24669](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/24669)
- New models: GLM-5.3-Flash (GLM5-Next), a 320B text+vision hybrid model [#27773](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27773), and the Clef decision model, fully supported with both text and vision [#29831](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29831) [#29969](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29969)
- Qwen4Exp: high-quality support is now available, with MTP speculative decoding (~1.5x decode speedup on DGX Spark) and various correctness fixes [#29761](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29761) [#29751](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29751)
- llama and server: new `/v1/systemone` API supporting five decision models - laya, julia-1, lev, openjev (+vision), kev [#29818](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29818)
- Metal: new tensor API flash attention kernel for F16 KV [#29570](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29570)
- Metal: new few-row MMA mat-mul kernels for speculative and batched decoding, up to ~3x faster mat-mul on Apple GPUs [#29869](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29869)
- New `llama_prefetch_rows()` using MADVISE-based prefetching of PLE tensors in Qwen4Exp and Gemma4 [#29599](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29599)

### API changes

- `include/llama.h`: new `llama_batch_ext` batch API with `llama_embd`, `llama_process()` and `llama_process_type` [#24669](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/24669), new `llama_get_causal_attn()` [#28876](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/28876), session formats bumped to `LLAMA_SESSION_VERSION` 11 and `LLAMA_STATE_SEQ_VERSION` 4
- `include/llama-cpp.h`: added `llama_batch_ext_ptr` and deleter for the new extended batch API [#24669](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/24669)
- `tools/mtmd/mtmd.h`: `mtmd_get_memory_usage()` now returns an `mtmd_memory_usage` struct with `image_max_tokens` and `use_non_causal` [#29773](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29773)
- `tools/server`: new `/v1/systemone` endpoint for decision models [#29818](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29818) and `/v1/embeddings` now accepts typed vision/audio/video content [#29556](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29556)

### New models

- GLM-5.3-Flash (GLM5-Next): 320B KDA/DSA hybrid text+vision model with mHC and MoE [#27773](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27773)
- Clef decision model, fully supported with both text and vision [#29831](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29831) [#29969](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29969)
- Ling 3.0 VL, folded into the BailingMoeV3 architecture [#29151](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29151)
- Nimble decision model [#29844](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29844)
- Registered `Lfm2BidirectionalForMaskedLM` for LFM2.5-Encoder-230M/350M [#29862](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29862)
- Added `classifier_pooling` support for rerankers [#29627](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29627)

### Core changes

- Migrated examples, speculative decoding, mtmd and server to the new `llama_batch_ext` API [#29385](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29385) [#29601](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29601); batches now accept both embd and raw tokens [#29622](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29622)
- Added `llama_prec_policy` and a model-driven W4A4 (NVFP4/MXFP4) mul_mat path [#24364](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/24364)
- Qwen4Exp: halved indexer score memory [#29825](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29825), optimized mask constructions [#29824](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29824), re-enabled the `-sm` tensor [#28569](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/28569); GLM5-Next: unique scatter rows for dead indexer slots [#29745](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29745)
- KV cache: fixed restoring mismatched KV cache rotation [#28498](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/28498), fixed K/V and recurrent state cleanup after failed restores [#27530](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27530) and an invalid assert in recurrent memory [#29799](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29799)
- Speculative decoding: probabilistic sampling for simple draft and MTP [#27694](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27694), fixed n-gram drafts rejected at temp > 0 after truncation [#29924](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29924), preserved original batch order for layer inputs [#29019](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29019), stop accepting draft tokens at EOG [#29638](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29638)
- k-pool models: fixed unexpected graph reallocation [#29958](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29958) and clamped kpool re-pool bound to existing pools [#29805](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29805)
- Fixed tensor split for fused qkv with uneven K/V head sizes [#29294](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29294), gather recurrent states once so the reserve covers every split [#29856](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29856), and properly handle KV on training [#28520](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/28520)
- Context: do not re-reserve the scheduler when toggling `causal_attn` [#28751](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/28751)
- DFlash drafts: write Gemma embedding scale during conversion [#29802](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29802) and add dflash support for MiMo [#29650](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29650)

### Multi-modality changes

- Cap `max_image` to `n_ubatch` for non-causal models [#29773](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29773)
- Fixed the mel preprocessor in LFM2 audio [#29403](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29403)
- Migrated input processing to `llama_batch_ext` [#29385](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29385)

### Server changes

- New `/v1/systemone` decision-model API with dedicated decision pipeline [#29818](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29818), extended to the nimble decision model [#29844](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29844)
- Support vision input for Clef [#29969](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29969)
- `GET /v1/models` and `GET /models` now report model input/output modalities in a new `architecture` object [#29987](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29987)
- `/v1/embeddings`: accept typed content (vision/audio/video) input [#29556](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29556) and return HTTP 400 for invalid embedding requests [#29060](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29060)
- Allow RANK pooling batch splitting for causal LLM rerankers (Qwen3, Qwen3-VL) [#28876](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/28876)
- Reject partial media truncation [#24076](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/24076)
- Logging: self-contained colors and split child commands from logs in router mode [#29895](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29895), allow preset to set log file [#29334](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29334), fixed dead `LLAMA_ARG_HF_REPO_FILE` key in preset allow-list [#29938](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29938)
- Fixed laya abort by limiting `n_batch` to `n_ubatch` [#29903](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29903)
- Remove the built-in UI's service worker when the UI is not served [#29565](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29565)

### UI changes

- New model download pipeline [#27959](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27959), Hugging Face Hub data layer [#27947](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27947), model memory-fit estimation [#27957](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27957) and model id grammar for sidecars, quants and capability parsing [#27946](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27946)
- Type-safe API types, fetch helpers and download-ready models store plumbing [#29582](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29582)
- Shared model display primitives [#29644](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29644)
- Fixed missing `svg use` and animation elements in preview and download [#28962](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/28962)
- Use `toLocaleString()` formatting consistently across chat message statistics [#27990](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27990)

### ggml changes

- ggml updated to [v0.26.0](https://github.com/ggml-org/ggml/releases/tag/v0.26.0): a new `alloc_buffer_n`/`get_alloc_size_n` buffer allocation API, sparse flash attention kernels on SYCL, Vulkan and Metal, and major lightning indexer improvements (halved score memory, tiling, MUSA support). The CPU backend gains BF16 ops and a tiled k-quant mul_mat, CUDA gains a model-driven W4A4 (NVFP4/MXFP4) mul_mat path plus MMVQ shared-expert fusion, and the Hexagon backend adds a sampler and more quant types. Model loading is faster with stricter GGUF size validation, Windows ARM64 MSVC builds are enabled, and WebGPU/OpenVINO/OpenCL/SYCL pick up numerous new kernels, ops and fixes.

## Assets

**Nightly build:** [b11429](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/releases/tag/b11429)

## More info

- [Releases and versioning of `ggml-org` projects](https://github.com/ggml-org/ggml/discussions/1579)
